process_nodes.label: MEMS
process_nodes.note: The February 2026 filing reports volume-production ramping of silicon microphones, BAW filters, micromirrors and high-frequency devices. MEMS optical circuit switches were in risk trial production at that date.

summary: The Beijing FAB3 MEMS foundry completed its production line in September 2020 and began volume production in June 2021. By February 2026 it was mass-producing microphones, BAW filters, micromirrors and high-frequency devices, with other device families still in development or trial production. An April 2026 investor update reported monthly capacity of 15,000 wafers and a staged plan to reach 30,000. The Beijing operator was wholly owned by Sai Microelectronics in September 2026.
